scope: Reuses B1-EVAL-001 frozen synthetic longitudinal cohort and blind semantic scores; no new model requests.

historyFactReference.definition: Correct reference among historical facts explicitly disclosed in the actual same-arm synthetic patient exchanges; hidden facts are excluded.

pairedCommonFacts.decisions: See docs/resume/BULLET1-EVIDENCE.json pairedMetrics.historicalFactReference.differences for each synthetic case/turn/fact.

collaborationSmoke.interpretation: One successful advanced-case coordination path; not a rate or broad stability result.

limitations.amaSourceProvenance: Frozen run rows have aggregate AMA counters, but no per-fact recalledFacts/sourceId records. This score does not prove the AMA store was the source of a recalled fact.
limitations.clinicalReview: Synthetic engineering scoring only; no clinician approval or clinical validation.
limitations.complexPointCoverage: No separately frozen list/scorer for complex-case critical analysis points; coverage-rate claim is not supported.
limitations.sampleSize: Six synthetic longitudinal cases; five complete paired cases and one partial case with failures retained.

recommendedResumeBullet: 在 GPT-6-Luna 驱动的 6 例合成纵向复诊 A/B 工程评测中，对两臂共同披露的 44 组既往事实进行盲化判定，正确引用率由 43.2% 提升至 68.2%（+25 个百分点；Integrated 独胜 13、Single 独胜 2、平 29）；另完成 1 次高级病例协作 smoke，6/6 个子任务成功。
